answer_1.quote: We train the CodeLlama model on this massive dataset to emulate compiler behavior ... perform virtual compilations on existing code search datasets to produce an augmented assembly code search dataset.

answer_2.quote: A concise evaluation of the generated assembly code is carried out using the BLEU, ROUGE-L, and METEOR score ... we adopt a more contextualized assessment method, Binary Code Similarity Detection (BCSD), aligned with our code search task. In this task, we use CLAP for evaluation.

answer_4.quote: However, a thorough manual inspection reveals several distinct categories of mismatches ... we sample some generated assembly code for these languages and manually check these samples to verify the correctness of the assembly output
answer_4.guideline: Categorize mismatches between generated and real assembly code into predefined types: address differences, alternate operation expressions, register allocation variances, stack allocation discrepancies, and additional instructions.
